title: Color Web
wikitext:
[[Image:Vv-vs-cw.jpg|frame|right|Color Web vs. [[The Vicious Vikings]], 1999]]
Norwegian-Danish clan, most likely named after a Danish Internet cafe. Dissolved in 1999, supposedly because the players got in an argument following an unexpected loss to [[The Vicious Vikings]] (see screenshot) in the [[North-European Clan League]] that year.
